task_description: Pick up the charger, align its plug with the receptacle, and insert it fully.

observations.name: charger_base_pos
observations.description: Center of the charger base used for grasping.

observations.name: goal_pos
observations.description: Charger reference position at full insertion.

observations.name: goal_axis
observations.description: Receptacle insertion axis in world coordinates.

observations.name: charger_grasped
observations.description: Whether the robot currently grasps the charger.

stages.description: Approach the charger base, descend, and establish a grasp.
stages.rationale: Acquisition ends at the native grasp event rather than at a geometry-dependent TCP threshold.

stages.description: Transport the grasped charger to a pre-insertion pose aligned with the receptacle axis.
stages.end_condition: boolean_state(charger_grasped) >= 1.0 and lateral_distance(charger_pos, goal_pos, goal_axis) < 0.01 and orientation_error(charger_quat, goal_quat) < 0.25 and distance(charger_pos, goal_pos) < 0.08
stages.rationale: Use a dimensionless relative-pose norm with explicit 8 cm translation and 0.25 rad rotation scales; retain lateral, axial, and angular gates as physical safety conditions.

stages.description: Advance the aligned charger into the receptacle.
stages.rationale: Use a dimensionless relative-pose norm with the native 5 mm and 0.2 rad success scales; the environment success predicate remains authoritative.
